October 26, 2026
October 262026
Instant ACH verification, Apple Pay, close automation updates, and new options to personalize your Karbon experience
A better client payment experience is coming to Karbon Payments. Plus period close made easier with carry over alerts and new filters for bulk edits.More details
October 06, 2026
October 062026
Engagements is now available to all customers
Manage your full client and revenue lifecycle from proposals and engagement letters to work delivery, invoicing, and payments, all through Karbon.More details
September 28, 2026
September 282026
Custom views for every assignable item, take payments on client accounts, and build engagements faster
Organize every assignable item into custom dashboards, preview and bulk-send engagements, and collect payments on account. Plus, enhanced invoice controls, smarter time-entry prefilling, updated close automation checks, and a new payroll integration.More details
August 31, 2026
August 312026
Engagement pricing summary, post invoices, and custom folder templates
Present engagement pricing your way, post invoices without emailing to your clients, and set custom folder templates by services.More details
August 05, 2026
August 052026
End client back-and-forth with Client Questions and AI Document Validation in Aider’s Period Close Automation
One of the biggest delays during period close is collecting the right information from clients. 
With Client Questions and AI Document Validation now available in Aider's Period Close Automation, firms can ask questions directly from transactions, keep client conversations connected to the work being reviewed, and help ensure the right documents come back the first time.
More details
July 27, 2026
July 272026
Bulk engagement renewals, more billing visibility, document folder templates, and a refreshed header and side panel
This release adds several updates across engagements, billing and payments, documents, and the platform. You can now renew engagements in bulk, see every invoice on an engagement's billing tab, and post invoices without sending them. Documents can be organized with default folder templates that carry into the client portal, eSignature supports a set signing order, and Karbon now integrates with Juno for tax return preparation. A new header and side panel also began to roll out in phases.More details
June 29, 2026
June 292026
Automated engagement renewals, AI-assisted period close, and Gusto integration
Automate your renewal cycle, accelerate period close with AI, a new look coming to Karbon, plus the Gusto integration now available to all.More details
May 26, 2026
May 262026
View and pay invoices in Karbon for Clients, extended QuickBooks Online integration, new Triage view options, and more
Karbon for Clients now supports invoice viewing and payment, so clients can see what they owe and settle up directly in the portal with no extra emails required. The QuickBooks Online Advanced integration has been expanded to cover all Quickbooks Online product tiers.More details
May 04, 2026
May 042026
Rich text editor for emails now available globally 
The new rich text editor for emails in Karbon is now live for all customers. More details
April 27, 2026
April 272026
Period close automation powered by Aider, create work from engagements, Gusto integration, and more
Aider period close is now live for all US customers with a completely rebuilt experience, smarter checklists, and deeper Karbon integration. This release also brings the ability to create and configure work directly from the Engagements setup, plus eSignature expiry extensions that preserve existing signature progress, self-service API credential management, and configurable timesheet periods to match your payroll cycle.More details
